text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the autumn GⅠ rush fast approaching,
Hishi Miracle trains furiously toward it, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ouch, ow ow ow...?
choice_data_list: What's wrong, Hishi Miracle?
What's wrong, Hishi Miracle?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing major.
I'm sure it was just my imagination...
choice_data_list: Come on, show me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A minor trouble occurred.
Investigating the cause of the pain reveals...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whew, what a relief~.
It was just overwork.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I might have gone a bit overboard with my solo practice.
choice_data_list: You were doing this in secret?
Were you doing this secretly?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I did it that much, you know?
Just~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"At night, before going to sleep, I'll suddenly think that
I need to go running, or that I need to do some strength training..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: This sudden urge of 'I have to do this' just welled up inside me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The feeling—it just welled right up."
Ever since that summer, Hishi Miracle has
often repeated those words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was just "motivation" welling up
from steeling her resolve, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for making you worry.
But I'm okay! Really, I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Could the true nature of this feeling be...
choice_data_list: Are you feeling impatient, Hishi Miracle?
Are you feeling impatient, Hishi Miracle?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Rushing?
Am I... rushing things, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I'm really that impatient.
It's just, well……
choice_data_list: Just... what?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like I need to properly show
the real me, giving it my all..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If I give it everything I have and still fail...
then it really means I'm just no good.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: If that were to happen...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Then it would mean choosing me was a mistake, wouldn't it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Once they realize I'm not all that great, I'm sure...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feelings poured from her mouth in raw, disorganized fragments.
Piecing them together, I was finally able to grasp what she meant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Could it be that Hishi Miracle is...
choice_data_list: Are you afraid of giving it your all?
Are you afraid of giving it your all?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Are you scared... to show it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if... they really think that?
Ummm...
choice_data_list: Aren't you worried about being given up on?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Given up on...? T-That's...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I... don't like this? I really don't like this...
I mean...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"That's the absolute worst~...!
Are you gonna give up on me? If I can't do it?
Wait, hey!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I can still keep going...! I can do more!
I can't say I've given it my all just yet...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing her panic confirmed it.
The true identity of that welling emotion was—'fear.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to believe that...
if she gave it her all and still failed, there would be no excuses left.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Uuu, I didn't realize it myself, but is that really how I felt...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"If I try my hardest and still fail,
I won't be able to use the excuse
that I wasn't really trying..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To think showing everything...
would be this terrifying...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else has been doing this the whole time, huh.
Man, that takes some serious guts...
choice_data_list: You can do it too, Hishi Miracle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Can I really do it? But I'm...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I really hate being abandoned, you know?
I'm not good at being all alone~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer chose me because they thought,
'Maybe there's hidden potential in her'...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Once you realize "there's nothing ahead,"
your hopes kind of just end right there, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once all possibilities are laid bare,
the gamble is over. That may certainly be true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she just doesn't want to betray expectations
no matter what. But...
choice_data_list: It's okay even if it doesn't work out

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, even if it's no good, it's fine...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: “Are you saying it's fine for who I am inside to just end here, for this to be all there is?”
choice_data_list: Yeah, because this is a "gamble."
Yeah, because this is a "gamble."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's no such thing as a sure bet.
When you place a wager, what matters most is—
steeling your resolve and accepting that you might lose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that I had always believed that,
and that was why I bet everything on Hishi Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay if I fail.
Even if I lose... is it really okay?"
choice_data_list: Yeah.
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: “If this is as good as I'll ever get, you won't be disappointed in me, right?”
choice_data_list: I won't. There's no way I would.
I won't. There's no way I would.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I never stood by my Umamusume's side with such an arrogant attitude in the first place.
choice_data_list: Let's win together, and lose together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—!?
Win together, and... lose together...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Trainer is...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: If you truly feel that way...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Aaaah, thank goodneeess!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A cry that was neither clearly a scream
nor a sob escaped from her mouth.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, what a relief~.
That made things so much easier~~~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see, it's okay to fail.
Even if I give it my all and fail~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: When I think about that, a huge weight off my shoulders~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hishi Miracle wears a look of genuine relief on her face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It felt like she was finally able to put down the burdens she bore,
as well as the ones she never had to carry in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Come to think of it,
I'm just me after all~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No matter what I do,
I can't become someone else, after all.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's keep going just the way you are, Hishi Miracle!
Yeah, let's just keep going as the Hishi Miracle you are!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This version of me right here
is the me my Trainer believed in!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No putting up fronts! When it's tough,
it's tough! But I'll still do my best! That's the way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of the Senior Class autumn showdown,
Hishi Miracle finally seemed to have regained her natural self.
